digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure - CI workflow parity collection
propositions: _collect_node_ids launches nested pytest collection subprocess without --basetemp, causing its temp cleanup to potentially delete or stall on shared numbered temp root entries from concurrent runs
nested pytest session shutdown traverses shared numbered temp root via cleanup_numbered_dir/rmtree, risking deletion or traversal of another active run's temp tree
regression test must prove that a pre-existing sentinel survives unchanged when nested collection subprocess receives a private basetemp directory

_collect_node_ids must be modified to own a TemporaryDirectory and pass a caller-owned private --basetemp to nested pytest without changing collection selection, stdout parsing, return-code contract, or timeout
